profile_text.body:
Kyndryl is a public company, traded as KD, that was founded in 2021 and is headquartered in New York, NY, USA. On its own site the company says it designs, builds, manages and modernizes the mission-critical technology systems that the world depends on every day.

Its site gives considerable attention to AI. Kyndryl publishes a People Readiness Report, described as exploring why workforce readiness has become one of the most important factors determining AI success, and a 2026 edition of that report is said to reveal a decline in workforce readiness as AI adoption surges. The site also discusses AI-native enterprises that put AI at the core of their business, an episode of The Innovation Show x The Kyndryl Institute podcast in which five leaders discuss how AI is evolving current business models, and the need for organizations to rethink resilience as AI accelerates attackers' capabilities.

The company's profile lists a CIK of 0001867072. No products, lawsuits, or MCP servers are recorded for it.
